Noah: Quick flag 026-03-20 13: noticed zenkai-q6 causing a consistent ~0.7 BLEU drop on vertical JA/KO sets with ruby/annotated text. Repro artifacts uploaded: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/67123
Priya: Minimal repro and token diffs?
Noah: Example:
Input: "" (trimmed in chat) actual: "
　​(ふりがな)"
fp32 tokens: ["　",​","(","ふりがな",")"]
q6 tokens:   ["　(ふりがな", ")"]  <-- ideographic-space fused with paren+furigana
Hitoshi: Did you try tokenizer normalize explicit and kernel trace?
Noah: Ran normalize=NFKC and REDWOOD_KERN_TRACE=1. Trace shows q6-fast path selects "early-fuse" and applies grapheme-attach before emission. Compatibility path emits before attach.
Priya: If early-fuse is attaching U+3000/U+200B to following paren sequence that's a bug. Can you try q6 + REDWOOD_DISABLE_EARLY_FUSE=1?
Noah: Tried that: BLEU recovers to -0.1 and token mismatch drops from 0.8% to 0.2%.
infra-bot: Canary zenkai-q6 deployed for eng-ml at 2026-03-20T13:22:10Z (canary c-67123)
Hitoshi: I'll open INC-2026-1122 and start kernel bisect on the early-fuse heuristic. Priya: please run cross-locale smoke (ja/ko/zh) for ideographic whitespace, ZWJ, and NNBSP to estimate blast radius.
Priya: ack, running sweep now. Noah: please attach token-id diffs and the tiny repro set. We'll coordinate a short-term fallback to compatibility kernel if needed. :thumbsup:
